title: Byzantine-Robust Federated Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36660v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study federated learning (FL) with adversarial clients, where the goal is to minimize the average loss of the honest (non-adversarial) clients without knowing their identity. Under heterogeneity, a single shared model parameter is statistically inappropriate: it cannot capture the distinct data-generating processes across clients, incurring an irreducible model-heterogeneity bias and severely limiting robustness to adversarial clients (a.k.a. Byzantine-robustness). We address this problem through representation learning, where each client learns a personalized linear head, while collaboratively estimating a shared nonlinear representation through Byzantine-robust aggregation. We demonstrate that the heterogeneity among honest representation gradients is controlled by the representation error and statistical errors that decay either with the number of data samples per client ($\tau$) or the number of iterations ($T$). translated_title: 拜占庭鲁棒的联邦表示学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究存在对抗性客户端的联邦学习（FL），目标是在不知道诚实（非对抗性）客户端身份的情况下，最小化诚实客户端的平均损失。在异构性条件下，使用单一共享模型参数在统计上是不合适的：它无法刻画各客户端之间不同的数据生成过程，会导致不可消除的模型异构性偏差，并严重限制对对抗性客户端的鲁棒性（即拜占庭鲁棒性）。我们通过表示学习来解决这一问题：每个客户端学习一个个性化的线性头部，同时通过拜占庭鲁棒聚合来协作估计共享的非线性表示。我们证明，诚实客户端表示梯度之间的异构性由表示误差和统计误差所控制，这些误差会随着每个客户端的数据样本数量（τ）或迭代次数（T）的增加而衰减。特别是，我们（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种面向数据异构环境的拜占庭鲁棒联邦表示学习方法：每个客户端学习个性化的线性头部，同时通过拜占庭鲁棒聚合协作估计共享的非线性表示，从而在存在对抗性客户端时避免模型异构性偏差并提升鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a Byzantine-robust federated representation learning framework where each client learns a personalized linear head while collaboratively estimating a shared nonlinear representation via robust aggregation, mitigating model heterogeneity bias and improving robustness against adversarial clients under data heterogeneity.
